content: This space answers questions about bakery sales. The data is workspace.gold.sales_enriched, one row per sales transaction. It is the governed gold table that the sales_metrics Metric View also uses, so answers match the dashboards.

Revenue means SUM(sales_amount). Quantity sold means SUM(quantity). Transaction count means COUNT(DISTINCT sales_transaction_id). Average transaction value means SUM(sales_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT sales_transaction_id). Never use unit_price alone for revenue.

A franchise is a bakery store. Slice sales by product (product_name), franchise (franchise_name), franchise country (franchise_country), customer country (customer_country), payment method (payment_method), or day (sold_date). month_name gives the month.
The products are Golden Gate Ginger, Austin Almond Biscotti, Pearly Pies, Tokyo Tidbits, Outback Oatmeal, and Orchard Oasis. Payment methods are amex, mastercard, and visa.
